message: Thanks! A few quick questions: How many people live in your household? Roughly how much does the household earn from work per year before tax? message: Just one yes/no so I don't send you to the wrong programs: is your household's yearly pay from work, before tax, above $80,000?

summary: AL household of 4 (married couple, 2 kids, no disability, no one 65+, no pregnancy/under-5). Reports "good money" plus about $19,200/yr other income, and employer health coverage. Exact earnings and assets were not given after repeated asks. Likely over the limits for most programmes, so none recommended. A caseworker should confirm income for CHIP, school meals and CTC.
